import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-65/testbed/data/house_price_index.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
rows = [(r[0].year, r[1]) for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=12, values_only=True) if r[0] and r[1]]
# compute recent growth rates
for i in range(len(rows)-5, len(rows)):
    y, v = rows[i]
    y0, v0 = rows[i-1]
    print(f'{y}: {v:.2f}, YoY: {(v/v0-1)*100:.2f}%')
# overall average growth
first = rows[0][1]
last = rows[-1][1]
n = len(rows)-1
cagr = (last/first)**(1/n)-1
print(f'CAGR {rows[0][0]}-{rows[-1][0]}: {cagr*100:.2f}%')
# last 10 year CAGR
first10 = rows[-11][1]
last10 = rows[-1][1]
cag10 = (last10/first10)**(1/10)-1
print(f'CAGR {rows[-11][0]}-{rows[-1][0]}: {cag10*100:.2f}%')
# prediction 2024 using last 5 year avg growth
import statistics
growths = [(rows[i][1]/rows[i-1][1]-1) for i in range(len(rows)-5, len(rows))]
avg = statistics.mean(growths)
print(f'Avg growth last 5 yrs: {avg*100:.2f}%')
print(f'Prediction 2024: {last*(1+avg):.2f}')
